Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the SOC 2 Type II report you shared last quarter. Verdant Health is conducting a vendor review ahead of our board audit and we need a short formal bridge letter that confirms there have been no changes to the controls in-scope (or otherwise explains any changes) since the report period ended.

Details: the report covers the period ending 2026-06-30. Our internal audit calendar requires coverage through our FY close (we need assurance from 2026-07-01 through today) and any material control or architecture changes that would affect the assertion.

We understand some items may be redacted.

Preferred turnaround: two weeks if possible. Also please let us know if Verdant’s request requires an SLA/contract amendment or DPA addendum.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Alex
